finalOutput:
Created the complete Snake game with all requested features in a single HTML file. The game includes:

**Core Gameplay:**
- 30x30 grid with smooth movement
- Four-directional controls (keyboard + touchscreen)
- Food consumption with snake growth
- Collision detection for walls and self-collision

**Three Game Modes:**
- Human vs Human (both players controlled manually)
- CPU vs Human (one AI, one player)
- CPU vs CPU (both AI-controlled)

**AI System:**
- CPU snakes automatically search for food using pathfinding
- AI chooses moves based on Manhattan distance to food
- Valid move checking (walls, self, other snake)

**UI Features:**
- Start menu with mode selection
- Game over screen with final score and winner message
- Real-time score display
- Snake 1 (green) and Snake 2 (blue) scores
- Visual feedback for game states

**Controls:**
- Arrow keys or WASD for manual movement
- Click/tap on canvas for touchscreen control
- Press 'R' to restart after game over

The file is ready to play with all requested functionality integrated into one file.

The snake moves continuously in one of four directions and grows when eating food. If it hits a wall or itself, the game ends. Implement keyboard controls for player movement. Add a CPU-controlled snake mode that automatically searches for food. Add the three game modes: human vs human, cpu vs human, cpu vs cpu. Display the score during gameplay. Include a start menu and game over screen. Allow restarting the game with a keypress. Use file name "snake_ollama-north-mini-code-1.0-latest_01.html"
